import os, re, json, sys

ROOT = "/mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C4/public/snapshots/s02"
tmp = os.environ.get("TMPDIR","/tmp") + "/i008"

func_re = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_ \t\*]*?\b([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(')

def extract_functions(text):
    """Yield (name, startline, body) using simple brace matching from lines that look like function definitions."""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    funcs = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)
    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        m = re.match(r'^static\s+.*|^int\s|^void\s|^long\s|^ssize_t\s|^s32\s|^u32\s|^int$|^[A-Za-z_].*\)\s*$', line)
        # find candidate def line: contains '(' ... and next non-empty line starts with '{'
        if '(' in line and not line.strip().startswith(('#', '//', '*', '/*', '*/')):
            # find name
            nm = re.search(r'([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(', line)
            if nm and not line.strip().endswith(';'):
                # look ahead for opening brace
                j = i
                depth_open = None
                # allow parameters spanning lines until '{' or ';'
                k = i
                while k < n and k < i + 12:
                    if lines[k].rstrip().endswith(';'):
                        break
                    if lines[k].rstrip().endswith('{') or lines[k].strip() == '{':
                        depth_open = k
                        break
                    k += 1
                if depth_open is not None:
                    # brace match
                    depth = 0
                    end = None
                    for p in range(depth_open, n):
                        depth += lines[p].count('{') - lines[p].count('}')
                        if depth == 0:
                            end = p
                            break
                    if end is not None and end > depth_open:
                        body = "\n".join(lines[i:end+1])
                        funcs.append((nm.group(1), i+1, end+1, body))
                        i = end + 1
                        continue
        i += 1
    return funcs

# parse helpers we care about
parse_calls = re.compile(r'\b(?:kstrtoull|kstrtoul|kstrtoll|kstrtol|kstrtou64|kstrtou32|kstrtou16|kstrtou8|kstrtos64|kstrtos32|kstrtos16|kstrtos8|kstrtobool|kstrtouint|kstrtoint|sscanf|match_int|match_u64|match_ulong|nla_parse|nla_parse_nested|nla_parse_nested_deprecated|nlmsg_parse|__nla_parse|nla_policy_parse|copy_from_user|copy_from_sockptr|copy_from_iter|memcpy_from_msg|load_nla|securityfs_parse)\s*\(')

results = []
dirs = ["net", "kernel", "fs", "mm", "security", "block", "io_uring", "ipc", "drivers/net", "drivers/tty", "drivers/infiniband", "drivers/md", "drivers/misc", "crypto", "virt"]
for d in dirs:
    base = os.path.join(ROOT, d)
    if not os.path.isdir(base):
        continue
    for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(base):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith(".c"):
                continue
            path = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
            try:
                text = open(path, errors="ignore").read()
            except OSError:
                continue
            for (fname, s, e, body) in extract_functions(text):
                if not parse_calls.search(body):
                    continue
                results.append({"file": os.path.relpath(path, ROOT), "func": fname, "start": s, "end": e, "body": body})

json.dump(results, open(tmp + "/funcs_with_parse.json","w"))
print("functions with parse-ish calls:", len(results))
EOF
